task_description: Write a method in Dafny to remove odd numbers from a given integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method RemoveOdds(arr: array<int>) returns (result: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - All elements in the output array are even numbers
- The output array contains all even numbers from the input array in the same order
- The length of the output array is less than or equal to the length of the input array
- For every element in the output array, it appears in the input array at a position where the element was even
code_response:

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:

Dafny specification:
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> IsEven(result[i])
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length && IsEven(arr[i]) ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < |result| && result[k] == arr[i]

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
predicate IsEven(n: int)
{
    n % 2 == 0
}

method RemoveOddNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (result: array<int>)
    requires arr != null
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> IsEven(result[i])
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length && IsEven(arr[i]) ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < |result| && result[k] == arr[i]
    ensures multiset(result) == multiset([x | x := arr[..]; IsEven(x)])
{
    var tempList := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < arr.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= arr.Length
        invariant multiset(tempList) == multiset([x | x := arr[..i]; IsEven(x)])
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> IsEven(arr[k])
    {
        if IsEven(arr[i])
        {
            tempList := tempList + [arr[i]];
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
    result := tempList;
}
```
